request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) expires **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

**Before then, you should:**

- **Attend your extension appointment** at the Ausländerbehörde on **Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30** [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp] and file the extension application there — filing before the permit expires means your stay is deemed to continue until a decision is made (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG) [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- **Bring the required original documents** (passport, enrolment certificate, proof of financing, health insurance proof, biometric photo, rental contract) to the appointment [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp].
- **Pay the fee on site by card** (cash isn't accepted) at the appointment [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- **Check your passport's validity**: a residence permit usually can't run longer than your passport, and your passport is due for renewal around **Wed 10 Feb 2027** ["not confirmed", check the letter] [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse].
- **If you can't make the appointment**, cancel it at least three business days beforehand so the slot can be reassigned [item:itm_5frk207bsfq1].

Without a timely extension request, lawful residence status ends when the permit expires [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. Given the immigration stakes, it may be worth getting advice if anything about your documents or eligibility is unclear.
